history.body: Hi, we have a young child and our rental is getting a bit tight. Is the 3-bedroom layout practical for a small family?

Yes, it looks worth considering for a small family: the Phase 1 layout is 900 sq.ft. with 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony. With a young child, the extra room could give you space for a nursery or a flexible family room, while the open-plan living, dining and kitchen area keeps shared time together. The layout also avoids a long internal corridor and includes a small storage area. A viewing would let you judge whether the room sizes feel right for your family’s routine.

That’s our main concern since we spend most of our time together there. 900 sq. ft. can feel quite different depending on the layout—do you know if there’s enough space for both a sofa area and dining table?

That’s a fair concern. The living and dining areas are open-plan, but I can’t confirm from the 900 sq. ft. figure alone whether your sofa and dining table will both fit comfortably. I’ll get the approved Type A plan checked for the living/dining dimensions so you can judge the layout more confidently.
